tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Latin Iulius, associated with iuvenis, 'young', or with the root for 'downy'. Its root is Latin iuvenis. A Roman family name; borne by early Christian saints. Julia is a Latin name meaning “Youthful; downy”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
